verses.1: O come, let us sing to the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
verses.3: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.5: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land .
verses.6: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
verses.7: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, if ye will hear his voice,
verses.8: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.9: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.10: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.11: To whom I swore in my wrath, that they should not enter into my rest.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), simplified for children aged 8-12. Faithful to the KJV tradition.
